title: Quiz: Beautiful Soup: Build a Web Scraper With Python
description: In this quiz, you'll test your understanding of web scraping using Python. By working through this quiz, you'll revisit how to inspect the HTML structure of a target site, decipher data encoded in URLs, and use Requests and Beautiful Soup for scraping and parsing data.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of web scraping with Python, Requests, and Beautiful Soup .
